objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to lifecycle control including creation, release, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification level such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid before requiring validity extension.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after invalidation during which the document is retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document released together with its main document, subject to its own versioning and affecting the main document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary sub-document not subject to the release cycle of the main document and directly publishable via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed independently of the document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expiry, requiring workflow-supported processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and initiate its archiving, processed through a defined workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who may hold one or more roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License role assigned to the user (e.g. Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for authorization assignment and distribution list management.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The set of user groups and individual persons assigned to receive a document via email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Whether distribution is by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance guiding tasks through defined steps such as Creator, Review, and Release.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded signature by a workflow participant confirming completion of a workflow task, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Role of the signer (author, reviewer, releaser).

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for metadata insertion.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The MS Office format of the template (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected for the newly created document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: perform_review
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical or formal correctness and completes the review task with electronic signature.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the review.

evts.name: perform_release
evts.description: A releaser approves or rejects the document for distribution, completing the task with electronic signature.

attributes.name: release_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the release.

evts.name: reject_in_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is officially released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document directly without impacting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by any user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) processes the validity extension check via workflow.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Extend validity, revise document, or initiate override.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow (releaser only or 3-step with initiator, reviewer, releaser).

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Approval or rejection of the override.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; all rights except archive group are revoked, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow-supported acknowledgement task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after its archive period has expired.
